findings.title: Cross-project publication rendering
findings.summary: PR61 closed project identity in supported paths, but executable base sync remains Poet-hardcoded and accepts arbitrary managed communities.
findings.action: Make base executor project-aware or internal-only; keep one public entrypoint.

findings.title: SQLite reliability pragmas
findings.summary: WAL, busy_timeout=5000 and foreign_keys=ON merged in PR61.
findings.action: Retain regression tests only.

findings.title: HTTP client per request
findings.summary: Inventory and major writer/OAuth paths migrated in PR62/63; YouTubeCommentWriter and remaining sites still need inventory.
findings.action: Complete lifecycle migration without changing mutation retry semantics.

findings.title: Upload ticket journaled too late
findings.summary: Base sync stores upload record only after upload and processing verification.
findings.action: Commit intent and reservation ticket before upload; reconcile unknown outcomes.

findings.title: Visible remote object treated as reusable
findings.summary: Any read_video result for journal remote_id is reused without verified stage/readiness/content checks.
findings.action: Verified-only reuse or full exact reconciliation.

findings.title: Weak upload readiness contract
findings.summary: wait_until_available returns when processing/converting are false, without duration/type/playability contract.
findings.action: Define provider readiness postcondition.

findings.title: Content records not fully validated in load_records
findings.summary: load_records calls parse and collection validation, not validate_content_record.
findings.action: Fail closed in preview and plan build.

findings.title: YouTube read requests lack bounded retry
findings.summary: YouTubeApiClient._get performs one request and fails complete scans on transient errors.
findings.action: Add classified read-only backoff.

findings.title: Duplicated VK transport and retry classification
findings.summary: Reader, writers and wave gateways implement overlapping HTTP/error logic.
findings.action: Centralize transport while keeping operation-specific retry policy.

findings.title: No configurable proactive VK limiter
findings.summary: Most flows react to provider errors after the fact.
findings.action: Add configurable limiter with verified provider policy.

findings.title: video.save auto_publish/repeat contract
findings.summary: Audits conflict about official parameter support; wallpost=0 is present, other flags require primary/live verification.
findings.action: Run read-only/one-canary contract research before code mandate.

findings.title: Wall publication separated from upload
findings.summary: Operational policies enforce separation in several flows, but no single universal upload postflight contract exists.
findings.action: Manifest wall_mutation_authorized=false plus before/after wall audit.

findings.title: PowerShell/operator fragmentation
findings.summary: Multiple Python launchers, stdout parsing, paths, encodings and latest-ZIP selection were confirmed on audit baseline and not addressed by PR61-63.
findings.action: Fresh inventory then consolidate runner contract.

findings.title: Wave generations and monkeypatch chains
findings.summary: Supported textsafe sync still monkeypatches a legacy base executor; multiple historical wave generations remain.
findings.action: Stable engine, dependency injection, archive retired paths.

findings.title: Critical executor test coverage
findings.summary: Historical coverage showed low coverage in CLI/writers and scripts outside normal coverage.
findings.action: Set module-specific targets and fault-injection tests.

findings.title: Album mapping by normalized title
findings.summary: Base sync maps live albums by normalized title and cannot safely represent duplicate names.
findings.action: Exact mapping and explicit conflict.

findings.title: Media cache selection by glob
findings.summary: Existing video_id*.mp4 can be selected before exact final path and integrity checks.
findings.action: Authoritative yt-dlp final path and cache fingerprint.

findings.title: System Uploads playlist creates VK album
findings.summary: Later primary-source verification showed playlists.list mine excludes system-generated uploads.
findings.action: Do not implement a fix for this claim.

findings.title: VK chunk/resume upload
findings.summary: No verified provider-supported protocol was established.
findings.action: Do not invent; solve with journaled ticket and reconciliation.

findings.title: Theological article photo wave
findings.summary: 10/10 postponed posts verified, IDs 12471-12480.
findings.action: Archive old generations; do not rerun Apply.

findings.title: Legendary Poet Shorts exact inventory
findings.summary: Latest reviewed state: 56 total, 41 exact pairs, 15 missing, 0 ambiguous; V3 Apply not proven in supplied evidence.
findings.action: Confirm canary execution state before any upload.

findings.title: Lord God upload/Shorts reconciliation
findings.summary: Issues 31/32/36/37/38 remain open and current-state documentation is stale.
findings.action: Reconcile exact IDs and unknown outcomes after core P0 hardening.

findings.title: MP3 browser automation boundary
findings.summary: Browser-based VK Audio flow lives in mp3telegrambot with different provider contracts.
findings.action: Define manifest/result interface before integration.

findings.title: Stale current-state documentation
findings.summary: current-state.md was synchronized on 2026-08-04 with PR61-63, article-wave completion, project queues, and blockers.
findings.action: Keep synchronized after every wave/run.

findings.title: Stale draft delete orchestrator PR29
findings.summary: Draft PR29 was closed without merge as superseded; reusable ledger/reconciliation ideas were preserved in issues 64/65.
findings.action: Never rerun historical deletion executors.
